contract.title: OpenAQ
contract.intent: Explore whether OpenAQ can support a small recent air-quality workflow.
contract.summary: OpenAQ provides air-quality observations through a REST API and public archive. This draft keeps the first workflow narrow: recent PM2.5 and NO2 observations for one city or small area.
access_methods: REST API using an X-API-Key header
Public AWS archive for larger historical file-based access

fields.name: no2
fields.units: ug/m3 or ppm depending on source metadata

defaults_used: Small pollutant set: pm25 and no2
Short recent date range, at most 7 days
assumptions: The first workflow should prove access and shape before attempting broad historical ingestion.
The user will choose the city or area before pipeline planning.
risks_or_unknowns: Availability varies by place, pollutant, station, and date range.
License and attribution requirements may vary by upstream provider and should be preserved downstream.

evidence.title: OpenAQ API Docs
evidence.note: Primary documentation for OpenAQ API access and resources.

evidence.title: OpenAQ API Key
evidence.note: Documents API-key access using the X-API-Key header.

advanced_options.archive_access: Open Data on AWS can be considered later for larger historical pulls.

contract.recommended_next_step: Confirm the city or area, date range, and whether raw or hourly observations are preferred.

candidate.name: OpenAQ
candidate.description: Global air quality data platform and API.
candidate.user_goal: Explore whether this can support a small air-quality workflow.
